pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark contiguous regions exhibit highly irregular, stellate geometry with sharp, jagged edge gradients. Spatial area is largest and most cohesive on the upper neck and shoulder, becoming significantly smaller and more fragmented toward the posterior flank and hindquarters.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: The light-colored negative space forms a continuous interconnected lattice. Junction nodes primarily consist of tri-radial intersections. Pixel thickness of the pathways remains relatively uniform across the mid-flank with high topological continuity.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the upper neck displays a high-frequency, low-amplitude serrated silhouette consisting of short, fine vertical textural protrusions.
